acquisition_method.evidence: experiment types: Bottom-up proteomics; Data-dependent acquisition

inferred: Mass spectra were acquired in a data-dependent mode utilizing a single MS survey scan (m/z 350–1650) with a resolution of 60,000 and MS/MS scans of the 15 most intense precursor ions with a resolution of 15,000.

cleavage_agent.evidence: Bands were excised and digested wit trypsin using a standard protocol (Shevchenko et al,).

enrichment_method.evidence: The supernatant containing the biotinylated surface proteins was then harvested, and loaded and ran on an SDS-PAGE for purification.

instrument.evidence: Peptides were reconstituted in 15 µL of 0.05% trifluoroacetic acid, 4% acetonitrile, and 6.6 µL were analyzed by an Ultimate 3000 reversed-phase capillary nano liquid chromatography system connected to a Q Exactive HF mass spectrometer (Thermo Fisher Scientific).

ionization_type.evidence: inferred: Peptides were reconstituted in 15 µL of 0.05% trifluoroacetic acid, 4% acetonitrile, and 6.6 µL were analyzed by an Ultimate 3000 reversed-phase capillary nano liquid chromatography system connected to a Q Exactive HF mass spectrometer (Thermo Fisher Scientific).

labeling.evidence: Data were searched against the human reference proteome downloaded from Uniprot (75,074 sequences, taxonomy 9606, last modified March 10, 2020) using the default parameters except for the following changes: label-free quantification (LFQ) enabled, match between runs enabled, iBAQ enabled, max missed cleavages: 3.
